tickets.title: Complete access recovery checks
tickets.text: Complete access recovery for Julian Mossbutton’s Moonbadger Robotics retirement plan portal, which is blocked by multi-factor authentication still using an old phone number. Restore portal access to review plan loan rules and contribution settings.
tickets.evidence: Employer plan access recovery was completed on 2024-04-09 after Julian could not open the Moonbadger Robotics retirement plan portal because multi-factor authentication still used an old phone number, blocking review of plan loan rules and contribution settings.

tickets.title: Gather debt refinance review details
tickets.text: Collect the current mortgage payoff quote, full HELOC statement, and any prepayment-penalty language from Clockwork Clover Mortgage and Teacup Comet Bank to enable a complete refinance review.
tickets.evidence: Loan document collection was completed on 2024-04-09, with the current mortgage payoff quote, full HELOC statement, and any prepayment-penalty language not available during the conversation, limiting a complete refinance review.

tickets.title: Gather debt refinance review details
tickets.text: Model the HELOC payment impact for Julian Mossbutton as the home-equity line of credit at Teacup Comet Bank moves from interest-only to amortizing payments on 2024-05-01. The lender’s reset notice estimated the new payment at about $925 per month.
tickets.evidence: The HELOC reset response was completed on 2024-04-09; the Teacup Comet Bank reset notice showed the home-equity payment moving from interest-only to amortizing, and Julian wanted the payment impact modeled with and without rolling the line into a broader refinance structure.

tickets.title: Gather debt refinance review details
tickets.text: Reconcile Julian Mossbutton’s Thimble Harbor Credit Union auto loan payoff amount against the latest monthly statement. The phone-system payoff amount did not match the statement, and the difference affects the debt-repayment order.
tickets.evidence: Auto loan payoff reconciliation was completed on 2024-04-09 after Julian reported one payoff amount from the Thimble Harbor Credit Union phone system that did not match the latest monthly statement, and the difference affects the debt-repayment order.

tickets.title: Complete cash-flow update after household income change
tickets.text: Update the household cash-flow budget for Julian and Lena Mossbutton following Lena’s reduced work schedule. The regular monthly take-home pay is expected to be about $9,250 under the reduced schedule, and the revised budget is needed before setting a target for accelerated debt repayment.
tickets.evidence: The cash-flow update after the household income change was completed on 2024-04-09; Lena’s reduced work schedule lowered household take-home pay, and the revised budget is needed before setting a target for accelerated debt repayment.

tickets.title: Complete tax-aware investment liquidation review
tickets.text: Review the taxable investment account at Velvet Acorn Custody for appreciated holdings that could be used for debt reduction, and estimate the tax impact before selling investments as a funding source.
tickets.evidence: The tax-aware investment liquidation review was completed on 2024-04-09; a review of the taxable account showed appreciated holdings that could be sold for debt reduction, and the tax impact needs to be estimated before using investments as a funding source.

tickets.title: Coordinate CPA on interest treatment and investment sales
tickets.text: Coordinate with Julian and Lena Mossbutton’s CPA to receive the debt-restructure assumptions, potential investment-sale amounts, and questions about home-equity interest treatment for the current tax year.
tickets.evidence: CPA coordination on interest treatment and investment sales was completed on 2024-04-09 after Julian asked that the household’s CPA receive the debt-restructure assumptions, potential investment-sale amounts, and questions about home-equity interest treatment for the current tax year.
